theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_dlen_matrix_diagonalization
theorems.statement: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (m : ℕ) (D : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) A), D.det ≠ 0 → ∃ (P Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) A) (d : Fin m → A), IsUnit P ∧ IsUnit Q ∧ (∀ i, d i ≠ 0) ∧ P * D * Q = Matrix.diagonal d
theorems.natural_summary: Induction on matrix size using accepted dividing-member and pivot-splitting dependencies, followed by composition of block transformations.
